pedal: Boss CS-3 Compression Sustainer (mono: Input -> Output)
comment: Prospective detector generalization test. Each carrier contains -36 -> -12 -> -36 dB and -24 -> -6 -> -24 dB jumps, four seconds per plateau. Levels are relative to the existing guitar-peak reference. Two fixed control settings: Level/Tone/Sustain noon, Attack minimum or maximum. Compare with the existing amplitude-domain model using the previously fitted detector constants; do not retune dynamics per frequency or jump size. The lower first quiet level probes recovery across the knee, while the second packet tests a smaller excursion at higher levels. Model reference commit 0a346743de472e253869e43887a02727c6a73322.
